rubric.evidence: models/chinese-spell-check/worker.js runs the REAL BertForMaskedLM (shibing624/macbert4csc-base-chinese, WASM fp32) directly: one forward pass over the whole sentence, per-position argmax over the 21,128-token vocab = the corrected character; diff vs input = the changes. VERIFIED LIVE 2026-08-04 in headless Chrome: '今天天汽很好，我想去公圆散步。他问我要不要去一家新开的歺厅。' → '今天天气很好，我想去公园散步。他问我要不要去一家新开的餐厅。' — 天汽→天气, 公圆→公园, 歺厅→餐厅 all corrected (汽→气 p=0.98), 229ms on WASM. bert/BertForMaskedLM class registered in the shared 3.7.5 pin.

correct() returns {corrected, changes:[{pos,from,to}], confidences[], seq, ms, device}. Semantic sanity verified live: homophone typos fixed with per-char confidence; a correct sentence returns unchanged (no false-positive fixes in the verified sample).

At-a-glance declares exact source id shibing624/macbert4csc-base-chinese (linked), task fill-mask (used for Chinese spelling correction), architecture MacBERT/BERT MLM fine-tuned for CSC, dtype fp32 (only fp32 export exists — 474MB single-file), backend WASM, license Apache-2.0, web APIs. model-loader entry matches. NOTE (documented in the worker): transformers.js 3.7.5 AutoTokenizer drops `subfolder` and rejects path/URL forms, so the tokenizer is constructed manually via the library's own `new BertTokenizer(json, config)` call from the repo's onnx/ files; the model uses the default onnx subfolder.
Uses lib/model-loader.js createModelLoader (shared auto-init; Download only when absent; Update/Re-download/Clear per state). No bespoke Load button.
status line surfaces checking→initialising→ready via the loader; 检查中…/完成。/检查失败: <message> with .err styling; worker errors propagate; retry = re-run. Offline/eviction handled by the shared loader.
Sample chips (click + keyboard), textarea, check button. Native controls; status role=status aria-live; output + changes areas aria-live polite.
Every correction is the model's real per-position argmax; the changes list shows the exact from→to + softmax confidence. Nothing canned.
Design-system classes only; native controls; live regions on status/output. Sub-24px tap targets likely on chips — flagged for the responsive matrix pass.
Uses the shared design system's responsive grid; chips wrap; output area wraps. Full 360x740 + 1280x800 matrix with real runs pending. support=needs-review on both classes until then.
All inference runs in the Web Worker; verified 229ms per correction on WASM (fp32 102M BERT). 474MB fp32 download is heavy-ish but honest (no quantized export); readout shows real ms.

guidanceConsulted.query: text correction output accessible live region diff display
guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Use semantic HTML and native controls with visible focus; applied via native chips, aria-live status/output, and a structured changes list.

guidanceConsulted.query: keep INP low off main thread web worker inference
guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Keep heavy work off the main thread; applied by running the full forward pass + argmax in the worker and only rendering the corrected text + changes on the main thread.

openQuestions: Sub-24px tap targets (chips) on desktop/mobile — enlarge to ~44px during the responsive matrix pass.
Direct-MLM argmax is the simple CSC baseline (the paper uses a soft-masked detector); overcorrection on rare contexts is possible — the confidence column makes it honest.
474MB fp32 is the only export — a quantized upstream export would halve it (watch upstream).
The tokenizer workaround (manual BertTokenizer construction) is documented in the worker; re-test on a transformers.js bump.
